# Hasiru Chamika

> Software engineer and SLIIT undergraduate based in Weligama, Sri Lanka. Builds full-stack web apps, Flutter and React Native mobile apps, agentic AI pipelines and ESP32-based IoT products.

## Selected projects

- [Unify](https://hasiruchamika.com/projects/unify): Multi-tenant SME operations platform with a four-agent booking pipeline. ASP.NET Core, React, Flutter, FastAPI, PostgreSQL
- [FloodWatch LK](https://hasiruchamika.com/projects/floodwatch-lk): Live flood and landslide risk for all 25 districts of Sri Lanka. Next.js, TypeScript, Open-Meteo
- [Plus Teacher App](https://hasiruchamika.com/projects/plus-teacher-app): Timetable, attendance and fee tracking PWA for tuition teachers. Supabase, PostgreSQL
- [SLFWS](https://hasiruchamika.com/projects/slfws): Machine learning early warning system for floods and landslides. Python, XGBoost, Streamlit
- [BoardingBook](https://hasiruchamika.com/projects/boardingbook): Roommate matching for university students on web and mobile. React, Node.js, MongoDB, Expo
- [BattleBot Control Stack](https://hasiruchamika.com/projects/battlebot): ESP32 combat robot, 1st place at EMBED X Robotics Workshop 2025
- [Raja AI Travel Guide](https://hasiruchamika.com/projects/raja-ai-travel-guide): 3D elephant avatar that answers Sri Lanka travel questions. Three.js, Groq
